posts.title: Distributive justice in blockchain economies
posts.description: For those still holding out hope for distributive justice in crypto-land, Adina Glickstein and I just published the paper for you: https://doi.org/10.1515/9783111329734-022 It includes valuable case studies from people who have been trying to do the right thing.

posts.title: From AI rabbit holes to a warm den: co-building the Inference Cooperative
posts.description: This is an apology, because I have done something I never had any intention of doing, and that would appall me if I learned a friend had done it: I have founded an AI startup. posts.title: Doodles on the landing page
posts.description: There are now hand-made doodles on the Inference Cooperative home page. It’s a small, superficial thing, but to me it matters: To make clear that the heart of this co-op is the people who join, not the AI tools we share. https://inference.coop
